name: Sorcerer fire chain
notes: ADR-0004's first sorcerer chain: Ember (ignite candles, ropes, oil) → Firebolt (a burning projectile) → Flame Jet (a held cone) → Fire Wall (a burning barrier). Each step is a new verb, learned from books; a deed can also teach Ember. Which books teach them, and the comprehension and mastery requirements, are mw-e07.7, mw-e07.8 and mw-e08.
